entities.summary: Armando Christian Pérez, known professionally as Pitbull, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor. He began his career in the early 2000s as a reggaeton, Latin hip-hop, and crunk performer, and signed with TVT Records to release his debut album, M.I.A.M.I. (2004). Executive produced by Lil Jon, the album entered the Billboard 200 along with his second and third albums, El Mariel (2006) and The Boatlift (2007). His fourth album, Pitbull Starring in Rebelution (2009), yielded his mainstream breakthrough, spawning the singles "I Know You Want Me " and "Hotel Room Service"—which peaked at numbers two and eight on the U.S.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Pitbull's mainstream breakthrough in 2009 led to significant commercial success, with 'I Know You Want Me' and 'Hotel Room Service' reaching the top 10 on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart. His subsequent albums solidified his position as a prominent figure in contemporary Latin music.
